children: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva overtook Senator Flavio Bolsonaro and held a tight lead in Sunday's presidential runoff election, the vote count from the country's electoral authority showed.
With 47.62% of ballots tallied, leftist Lula had 50.01% of the valid votes - which exclude blank and null ballots - against right-wing Bolsonaro's 49.99%, the count showed.
